objective: 在Phase55整体改进但仍未达到10%/15%合同门槛后，针对bin形状误差开展一次预注册的结构级OOF搜索；探索model×segment head、分组residual calibration、分组alpha和不同残差损失，最终只在所有候选冻结后打开一次development validation。

dataset_contract.group_isolation: six model rows of one profile stay in the same split and OOF fold
dataset_contract.phase50_blind: not read, not used for candidate generation, and not used for selection
dataset_contract.complete_requests: not read; only Phase48 compact feature/H0/Hfull rows are used

search_contract.adaptation_signal: OOF absolute score, model/segment heterogeneity, 12-bin signed bias and calibration residual; no validation signal may generate or rank candidates
search_contract.stage_b_policy: each OOF top candidate gets one capacity/head specialization variant and one calibration/shape variant
search_contract.candidate_selection: prefer complete OOF target/protection, then lower four-metric score, then lower histogram WAPE

predictor_contract.implementation: Phase54 deterministic NumPy residual predictor pinned by SHA, with target-free segment/model one-hot features and optional per-head OOF calibration
predictor_contract.calibration: calibration offsets are estimated from fit folds for OOF predictions and from honest OOF residuals for the final validation prediction; no validation target is used
predictor_contract.target_representation: encoded log-total plus 12-bin log-share residual from H0
predictor_contract.validation_rule: freeze candidate, calibration strength, alpha map and epoch from OOF; fit selected heads on all 960 train profiles; open 240 validation profiles exactly once

acceptance_gate.oof_protection: overall and every model strictly beat H0 on calls WAPE, bytes WAPE, calls TV and normalized payload EMD
acceptance_gate.development_formal_target: overall calls histogram WAPE <= 0.10 and bytes histogram WAPE <= 0.10
acceptance_gate.development_model_guard: each of six models has both histogram WAPE <= 0.15
acceptance_gate.development_segment_guard: each BurstGPT segment has both histogram WAPE <= 0.15 and composite ratio < 1
acceptance_gate.total_guard: overall calls total WAPE <= 0.05 and bytes total WAPE <= 0.05
acceptance_gate.next_permission: only a complete OOF-protected and validation-passing candidate may authorize a separate blind-freeze/evaluation workflow
acceptance_gate.negative_policy: integrity PASS with target_met=false is valid evidence that this structural budget did not reach the contract; it blocks blind evaluation and requires a new pre-registered workflow

stop_and_block_if: any pinned Phase48 or Phase54 source differs
Phase50 blind files or labels are opened
validation profiles are used to generate or rank candidates
raw or complete request rows are read or written
GPU, network, model download, original weights or cache are accessed
claim_boundary: development-only evidence on 1200 Phase48 profiles and six known model structures under pure P1-D1
not fresh blind evidence and not a Phase50 re-evaluation
not physical communication time, placement, latency, queueing, or online scheduling
